tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: unintegrated Lineup feature-icon study.

Input image 1 is the actual EDIT TARGET. Treat its artwork as locked geometry to recolor, not a reference to reinterpret. Make exactly one tightly bounded palette correction to this image.

Preserve the graphic silhouette, every shape and contour, exact geometry, placement, proportions, motif scale, spacing, thick readable strokes, and planar material of the input. Do not redraw, rearrange, enlarge, shrink, simplify, or add anything. Preserve the existing symbol.

Change only the colors and restrain the background gradient contrast. Use one principal hue, warm white or off-white, and only close tonal variants of the same hue when needed. Keep controlled rich color with a calm character. Do not make the icon grey or washed out. No neon, rainbow glyph, complementary accent, or multicolor pane fills.

The output must be one fully OPAQUE SQUARE with the background extending continuously to all four edges and all four corners. Preserve the source's edge-to-edge composition. No baked outer corners, rounded outer tile, transparency, margin, padding, border, or scene. A separate native preparation step will apply the shared macOS corners.

Keep all artwork flat and planar. No new shapes, textures, noise, shadows, relief, bevels, rims, shiny volume, gloss, radial highlights, ceramic, enamel, or physical keycap. The gentle background transition is color only, not simulated lighting. No text, labels, extra symbols, or logo redesign.

Subject: Zones. Preserve the input's exact three-pane arrangement with one tall left pane and two stacked right panes. Preserve pane rounding, dimensions, placement, and gutters.

Palette correction: calm cornflower/cobalt blue, principal hue near #386BD5. Replace the vivid blue background with a gentle diagonal color transition around #4276DC at the upper left to #315FC5 at the lower right. Recolor all three panes to the same warm white or very pale blue around #F4F6FA, with no noticeable multicolor difference among them. Completely remove orange and electric cyan. The three-pane shape supplies the visual interest. Do not change any geometry.

visual_inspection.scope: Saved original generated master inspected at source resolution against the raycast-v1 edit target. No native or final-size acceptance.
visual_inspection.observation: The tall left pane and two stacked right panes retain their arrangement, contour, rounding, and scale on visual comparison. All panes are off-white. Orange and electric cyan are absent. The blue field is less contrasting than raycast-v1.
visual_inspection.geometry_limit: Visually preserved. Pixel-identical contours are not guaranteed by imagegen.
